'''Bloodthirster Black''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and criminal who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Blood Razors]] in the [[Karthakk system]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Captain Darkscale frequently piloted a [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]] in the Karthakk system.<ref name="SWG:LS" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempGenericPirate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Captain Darkscale]]
Bloodthirster Black appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Bloodthirster Black was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. Bloodthirster Black was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Blood Razor starfighters in the Karthakk system.<ref name="SWG:LS" />
